description: Main source file for Wi-Fi supplicant management in Zephyr OS, handling interface setup, event processing, and thread initialization.

methods.name: get_default_context
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the supplicant context.

methods.name: zephyr_get_default_supplicant_context
methods.description: Provides access to the global wpa_supplicant context.

methods.name: zephyr_wifi_send_event
methods.description: Sends an event message to the supplicant via socket.

methods.name: is_wanted_interface
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is relevant for supplicant management.

methods.name: zephyr_get_handle_by_ifname
methods.description: Retrieves the wpa_supplicant handle for a given interface name.

methods.name: get_iface_count
methods.description: Counts the number of interfaces managed by the supplicant.

methods.name: add_interface
methods.description: Adds a network interface to the supplicant management.

methods.name: del_interface
methods.description: Removes a network interface from the supplicant management.

methods.name: submit_iface_work
methods.description: Submits a work task for interface management.

methods.name: iface_cb
methods.description: Callback for each network interface during setup.

methods.name: setup_interface_monitoring
methods.description: Initializes monitoring of network interface events.

methods.name: event_socket_handler
methods.description: Processes incoming socket messages for events.

methods.name: register_supplicant_event_socket
methods.description: Creates socketpair and registers event callback.

methods.name: handler
methods.description: Main thread handler for initializing supplicant, FST, and interface monitoring.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the supplicant thread at system startup.
